title: The cycle condition tested on φα gives ∫Dφ[v]dν = 0 for a Riesz vector v of α
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P, ζ₀ ∈ Λ_{d+1}(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P (d+1)), α a d-covector, v ∈ ℝ^P and φ : ℝ^P → ℝ a C^∞ function with compact support. Assume (i) ∫ζ₀(dψ(y))dν(y) = 0 for every test d-form ψ ∈ TestFormOn univ d, where dψ := exteriorDerivative ψ, and (ii) ζ₀(γ) = ⟨v, w⟩ whenever w ∈ ℝ^P and γ is a (d+1)-covector with γ(u) = Σ_{i=0}^{d} (−1)^i⟨w, u_i⟩α(Fin.removeNth i u) for all u. Then ∫Dφ(y)[v]dν(y) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P (d + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) d) (v : Euclid P) (φ : Euclid P → ℝ), (∀ ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, ∫ y, ζ₀ (exteriorDerivative (ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y) ∂ν = 0) → (∀ (w : Euclid P) (γ : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1)), (∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (inner ℝ w (u i) * α (i.removeNth u))) → ζ₀ γ = inner ℝ v w) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0
